finalText:
**Redis died and took prod down with it.**

At 02:14:07 `redis` refused connects at `10.0.0.12:6379` ([logs/app.log:182](logs/app.log:182)). Cache fell back to direct store reads. That triggered 173 `TimeoutError` lines. All 13 reconnect tries failed. Queue passed its 500 cap at 02:29:12.

`worker-2` died of `JavaScript heap out of memory` at 02:31:44. Supervisor killed `api` at 02:31:52 ([logs/app.log:719](logs/app.log:719)). No recovery line follows.

Log timestamps read 2026-07-04, not last night.

Next: find why Redis at `10.0.0.12` went down.
